# RJ Framing Inc.

> Custom home framing, additions, and structural steel installation across the Greater Toronto Area. Rough carpentry built right the first time — 5+ years, 100% inspection pass rate.

## About
RJ Framing Inc. is a framing contractor based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. Founded in 2020 and run by Ray, a Journeyman Carpenter, the company specializes in structural framing other crews turn down — cantilevers, high-load steel, and tight infill lots.

## Services
- Wood Framing — Custom homes, additions, renovations. From foundation to roof.
- Steel Framing — Steel-stud framing for commercial buildouts, multiplexes, and fire-rated assemblies.
- Steel Beams & Columns — W-flange beams, HSS columns, and moment frames installed to engineering specification.
- Back Framing — Renovation framing, bulkheads around mechanical services, and specialty ceiling details.

## Service Area
Greater Toronto Area and surrounding cities — Toronto, Vaughan, Aurora, Richmond Hill, North York, Scarborough, and Stouffville.

## Where framing sits in a build
RJ Framing is the trade between the foundation and the drywall: after permits, excavation and foundation; before mechanicals, insulation, drywall and finishes. RJ works as the framing and structural steel subcontractor for general contractors, architects and homeowners.

## Process
1. Drawings — Send the architectural and structural drawings plus engineering. RJ reviews them, flags anything that won't frame as drawn, and sends a written quote and start date. Reply within 24 hours.
2. Start date — Lumber, steel and trusses ordered off the drawings and timed to arrive with the crew. Work starts on the contract start date. Needs: foundation done, site clear.
3. Frame — Floors, walls, steel beams and roof built to the drawings and the engineer's spec. Wood and steel are both done by RJ, so there is no second crew to wait on.
4. Inspection and hand-off — RJ attends the framing inspection and fixes any deficiencies. Site swept and handed to the mechanical trades.
